subject.title: Skill and Read tools truncating output at ~600-700 chars in 2026.6.11

question: Should maintainers require a live packaged-gateway reproduction before authorizing cap or Skill Workshop fixes for this mixed report?
rationale: The obvious current and shipped source caps are much higher than the report, while the plausible causes span display sanitization, transcript compaction, model-visible context, provider wrappers, and workspace-scoped proposal lookup.

options.title: Require Live Repro First
options.body: Keep the issue open but block fix automation until a packaged v2026.6.11 or current-main Linux gateway run captures the exact cutoff and proposal lookup failure with transcript and workspace evidence.

options.title: Split Read Truncation From Workshop State
options.body: Track read-output clipping against the narrower related read issue while keeping this issue focused on Skill Workshop proposal state, accepting the risk of splitting a shared root cause.

options.title: Assign Source Investigation Now
options.body: Have an owner trace display, embedded-runner, provider, and workshop state paths from source immediately, accepting higher risk of chasing an unreproduced layer.

recommendation.title: Require Live Repro First
recommendation.body: Keep the issue open but block fix automation until a packaged v2026.6.11 or current-main Linux gateway run captures the exact cutoff and proposal lookup failure with transcript and workspace evidence.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest mixed-surface history across Skill Workshop tooling and current read/web/session runtime paths.
